name: ProgressBar
description:
The ProgressBar component displays a linear progress indicator for a task. It can be used in both determinate and indeterminate states, and supports different sizes and usage styles.

The root renders with `role="progressbar"` and the ARIA value attributes, so the abstraction only needs an `id`, a `label` and either a `now` value or `indeterminate`.

parts.name: El
parts.description: An abstraction for rendering a labelled ProgressBar with a determinate `now` value or an `indeterminate` state

props.name: id
props.description: A unique identifier for the progress bar. Required for accessibility.

props.name: label
props.description: A description label for the progress bar. Required for accessibility.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: The state of the progress bar.

props.name: now
props.description: The current value of the progress bar.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The root container of the ProgressBar component.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Strips Cerberus PandaCSS recipe classes while preserving behavior and WAI-ARIA attributes.

props.name: css
props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.
